scope: Actual original driver-control read/set-bit/write through both existing transfer services. All ordinary/banked/special CPU, FPU, RAM, device and boundary state compares. Additional semantic checks cover both transfer arguments, device events, exact control value, interrupt-mask restoration, result/link/stack registers, 256 actual delay iterations and exact known channel/status/counter effects and unchanged RAM elsewhere, excluding a 128-byte callee stack window. The primary oracle compares every stack byte. Initialized hardware-context fixtures and finite FIFO/control inputs are explicit software policy; no game service result is supplied. Host/privilege faults do not claim physical exception delivery; natural startup is tested separately.
